utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Jules — just help spread the word and point people to Sunday at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people to Sunday at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m thinking Sunday at the community center after 3:30. Do you need anything specific still, or should I just bring whatever I can spare?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — whatever you can spare would help, but we still need screwdrivers, tape, and a few sturdy boxes if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring screwdrivers, tape, and a few boxes on Sunday after 3:30. See you at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Dane — the repair drive is still happening, and I’ll send the pickup spot update soon so everyone can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — so it’s still on for 9 a.m. at the community center, and I’ll watch for the pickup spot update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — 9 a.m. at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll send the pickup spot update soon. Thanks for getting ready with the tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Opal. I’ll follow the plan and be at the pickup spots on time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep tracking the details, and I’ll let you know if anything changes. Thanks for staying flexible.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You bet, Opal. Just keep me posted, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not much yet — I’m still waiting to hear what’s needed. If you know anything, I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not yet, but I can send over the repair drive plan and pickup spots right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive today—want me to add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, please add me — I’m a bit forgetful, so a reminder would help. If you hear what supplies we still need, pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you to the invite list and keep you posted on what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — Rosa moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center and is gathering the biggest-needed items now. She’ll confirm the full list and meetup details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for Rosa’s full list and meetup details before I help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — we’re meeting at the community center at 9 a.m., and I’ll keep spreading the word. If anyone’s bringing supplies, I can help point them to the right drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — that’s really helpful. I’ll make sure anyone with supplies knows to bring them to the community center at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — thanks, Sam. I’ll keep letting folks know: community center at 9 a.m., and supplies can be dropped off there too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if it’s after 3:30, I can help. Do we know what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sam said it’s this Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center. I’m not sure what’s still needed, but I can pass along anything you want me to ask about.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — could you ask what supplies are still needed and whether there’s a pickup list? If it’s after 3:30, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still on for today — I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — so it’s definitely still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll stop by and bring a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — after 3:30 works best for me. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: After 3:30 works for me too — let’s meet at the community center around 9 a.m. and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help with setup, sorting the list, and greeting folks at the community center Sunday at 9 a.m. If you need more, I’ll bring a few tools too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ll bring the cordless drill, the spare screws, and a box for the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Noah — that’ll cover a lot. I’ll handle setup and greeting folks at the center Sunday at 9, and we’ll sort the list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on this Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center. We’re set for the repair drive, and folks should keep an eye out for the pickup spot update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep tracking supplies and watch for the pickup spot update. If you send me the list, I can help make sure we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the list so we can make sure everything’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like they mainly need tools and a few handy folks—mostly help with things like hinges and fence patches. I heard they’re meeting at the community center at 9 a.m., but I’d ask Mara about the pickup spots too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll meet at the community center at 9 a.m. with a few tools, and I’ll check with Mara about the pickup spots too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, that sounds like the plan — thanks for checking with Mara on the pickup spots too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure we’ve pinned down the exact time or supplies yet. If you want, I can help figure out what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Oren — that’d help. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — just let me know once you hear more, and I’ll help track down whatever we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair drive plan and the pickup spots, and then you can stick with that. Thanks for helping connect everyone!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—send me the plan and pickup spots, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll get the repair drive plan and pickup spots over to you next. Thanks again for helping make the connections!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If it’s after 3:30, I can help — do we know what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s still needed and where to drop it off. If you hear anything before then, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I appreciate it — just let me know once you find out, so I can plan around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — we’re meeting at the community center at 9 a.m., and I’ll keep spreading the word. If you hear of any extra supplies, just let me know and I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — 9 a.m. works for me, and I’ll let you know if I hear of any extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Faye — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too, and we’ll make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on today. Come by the community center at 9 a.m., and I’ll get you sorted with the setup crew.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. I’ll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the Sunday community center details once you have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — just to keep it straight, the details I have are Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center. If anything changes, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — thanks for the correction. I’ll treat it as Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — appreciate it. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 a.m. to help with sign-in and directions.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Uli — that really helps. I’ll check the tool list and line up a few more volunteers, then we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Dane. Just let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help, but I want to make sure I’ve got the repair drive details right first—what time and place are we using?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — Sunday at 10 a.m. at the community center. What would you like me to help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What items do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve got the tools covered, but we still need hands for setup, sorting the list, and greeting folks at the community center Sunday at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help spread the word. Do you still need anything besides volunteers for Sunday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll add you to the invite list for the repair drive. If you can make it, come by the community center at 9 a.m. for setup!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll be there at 9 a.m. at the community center and help with setup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Sam — thanks for pitching in! I’ll see you at the community center at 9 a.m., and feel free to keep spreading the word about the repair drive.
